title: aglaia mannii
intro: Aglaia mannii, commonly known as the Yellow Aglaia or African Pear, is a plant species belonging to the family Meliaceae. It is a valuable plant used in traditional medicine, providing several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiparasitic properties. The bioactive constituents present in Aglaia mannii include limonoids, flavonoids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-cancer, and anti-viral activities. The plant's therapeutic actions make it a potential candidate for the treatment of various diseases, including cancer, HIV, and malaria, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy and safety.
